description: End-to-end lifecycle management of B2B SD-WAN services including design, quoting, ordering, provisioning, change management, monitoring, and decommissioning.

customer_id.description: Unique identifier of the enterprise customer

site_id.description: Unique identifier for a customer site/location

service_id.description: Unique identifier of an SD-WAN service instance

design_id.description: Identifier for a specific SD-WAN design/topology proposal

quote_id.description: Identifier for a commercial quote associated with a design

order_id.description: Identifier of an SD-WAN service order

change_request_id.description: Identifier of a service change request

actor_context.description: Context about who is performing the action and from where.

actor_id.description: Identifier of the actor in the IAM system.

tenant_id.description: Tenant or organization scope, if applicable.

secret_ref.description: Optional secret reference for signed webhook delivery.

attachment_ref.description: Pointer to an uploaded attachment or document.

pagination.description: Pagination and sorting controls for list endpoints.

cursor.description: Optional opaque cursor for keyset pagination.

tag_set.description: Free-form key/value tags for categorization and search.

policy_rule.description: Generic policy rule with conditions and actions.

value.description: Value to compare against. Type depends on operator.

functions.name: design_sd_wan_topology
functions.description: Create a proposed SD-WAN topology and configuration design for a customer across multiple sites.

customer_id.description: Target customer for the SD-WAN design

sites.description: List of sites to be included in the SD-WAN design

access_requirements.description: Required access circuits for the site

application_profiles.description: Traffic/application classes originating/terminating at this site

policy_requirements.description: Global policy constraints and business intent

functions.returns: Created design_id with generated per-site and global SD-WAN topology proposal.

functions.name: validate_and_price_design
functions.description: Validate technical feasibility of a design and generate a commercial quote.

design_id.description: Identifier of the SD-WAN design to validate and price

include_breakdown.description: Whether to return per-site and per-component pricing breakdown

functions.returns: Validation result (feasible or not), list of issues if any, and quote_id with commercial breakdown and total recurring/non-recurring charges.

functions.name: create_sd_wan_service_order
functions.description: Create an SD-WAN service order from an approved quote and design.

site_groups.description: Optional grouping of sites for phased rollout

functions.returns: Created order_id, initial order status, and mapping between design entities and order line items.

functions.name: get_order_status
functions.description: Retrieve high-level and per-site status of an SD-WAN service order.

include.description: Additional details to include in the response

site_filter.description: Optional filter to limit to specific sites

functions.returns: Overall order state, per-site progression, key milestones, and any blocking issues.

functions.name: provision_sd_wan_service
functions.description: Trigger or re-trigger provisioning workflow for an SD-WAN service or specific sites.

order_id.description: Order whose components should be provisioned

site_ids.description: Required if scope is selected_sites or single_site

change_request_id.description: If this provisioning is tied to a change request

functions.returns: Provisioning job identifier, per-site provisioning intent, and initial execution state.

functions.name: register_and_bind_devices
functions.description: Register edge devices (CPEs) and bind them to SD-WAN service sites.

devices.description: List of devices to register and bind

site_id.description: Site to which this device should be bound

functions.returns: Registered devices with assigned device_id values, binding status to sites, and bootstrap credentials if applicable.

functions.name: activate_sd_wan_service
functions.description: Perform final checks and activate the SD-WAN service for selected sites or entire service.

failure_threshold_percent.description: Percentage of sites failing that triggers rollback

functions.returns: Activation job details, per-site activation state, and any test results or rollback actions initiated.

functions.name: list_and_monitor_sd_wan_services
functions.description: List SD-WAN services and retrieve operational/monitoring snapshots.

metrics_window_minutes.description: Time window for metrics if include_metrics is true

functions.returns: List of SD-WAN services for the customer with optional health, performance, and alert summaries.

functions.name: request_sd_wan_service_change
functions.description: Create a change request for an existing SD-WAN service (e.g., bandwidth, policy, site adds/removals).

change_details.description: Polymorphic change detail payload depending on change_type

functions.returns: Created change_request_id, initial approval state, and summary of requested modifications.

functions.name: apply_sd_wan_service_change
functions.description: Execute an approved change request against the SD-WAN service.
functions.returns: Change execution job details, current progress, and any immediate validation results.

functions.name: retry_or_rollback_operation
functions.description: Retry a failed provisioning/activation/change operation or roll back to the previous state.

override_parameters.description: Optional overrides to correct issues for retry (e.g., new IPs, credentials)

reason.description: Explanation for retry or rollback request

functions.returns: New recovery operation id, updated per-site state, and summary of changes or revert actions performed.

functions.name: suspend_or_terminate_sd_wan_service
functions.description: Suspend, resume, or permanently terminate an SD-WAN service or specific sites.

asset_disposition.description: Instructions for device and circuit handling on termination

functions.returns: Lifecycle action confirmation, effective dates, and any follow-up tasks (device returns, billing adjustments).

functions.name: get_sd_wan_service_details
functions.description: Retrieve full details of an SD-WAN service including design, topology, policies, and runtime state.
functions.returns: Comprehensive SD-WAN service representation with optional linked objects and operational/incident data.

functions.name: sd_wan_lifecycle_bulk_import
functions.description: Bulk import sd wan lifecycle entities from an external source (CSV, JSON, or upstream system) with validation, mapping, and partial-commit support.

external_query.description: Optional query used to pull records from upstream.

records.description: Inline records, used when source_type is 'json'.

field_mapping.description: Map of source field names to target schema fields.

functions.returns: Bulk import outcome including counts of created/updated/skipped/failed records, per-record errors, and a batch reference.

functions.name: sd_wan_lifecycle_bulk_update
functions.description: Apply a single update payload across many sd wan lifecycle entities matching a filter or explicit id list.

selector.description: How to choose entities for the update.

update.description: Field-level updates to apply. Polymorphic - one of set/unset/append.

functions.returns: Bulk update summary including total matched, updated, skipped (e.g. due to concurrency), and failures.

functions.name: sd_wan_lifecycle_bulk_delete
functions.description: Soft- or hard-delete (or archive) many sd wan lifecycle entities in a single operation with dependency checks.

cascade.description: Whether to cascade to related entities.

include.description: List of relationship names to cascade through.

functions.returns: Bulk delete result including counts of deleted/archived/skipped entities, dependency conflicts, and a tombstone reference.

functions.name: sd_wan_lifecycle_bulk_export
functions.description: Export sd wan lifecycle entities (and optional related data) to a downloadable artifact, optionally redacting sensitive fields.

include_related.description: Names of related collections to include.

field_projection.description: Subset of top-level fields to include.

functions.returns: Export job descriptor including job_id, expected size, status, and delivery details.

functions.name: sd_wan_lifecycle_search_advanced
functions.description: Faceted, full-text and structured search across sd wan lifecycle entities with relevance ranking and facet aggregations.

facets.description: Field names to compute aggregations over.

functions.returns: Search response with ranked hits, total count, facet bucket counts, and pagination cursor.

functions.name: sd_wan_lifecycle_subscribe_to_events
functions.description: Create a notification subscription for sd wan lifecycle events using one or more channels and event-type filters.
functions.returns: Subscription descriptor including subscription_id, enabled status, and validated channel configurations.

functions.name: sd_wan_lifecycle_list_webhook_deliveries
functions.description: List webhook delivery attempts for sd wan lifecycle notifications with filters for status, time window, and subscription.
functions.returns: Paginated list of webhook delivery records including attempt counts, response codes, and last error.

functions.name: sd_wan_lifecycle_get_audit_log
functions.description: Retrieve the audit trail for one or more sd wan lifecycle entities with actor, change, and diff information.
functions.returns: Paginated audit events ordered by time with field-level diffs when requested.

functions.name: sd_wan_lifecycle_schedule_recurring_job
functions.description: Schedule a recurring job (e.g. health probe, report generation, sync) related to sd wan lifecycle on a cron/interval/calendar schedule.

target.description: Target scope of the job (entity ids and/or filter).

parameters_payload.description: Job-specific parameters passed at each run.

functions.returns: Scheduled job descriptor including job_id, next_run_at, enablement status, and schedule summary.

functions.name: sd_wan_lifecycle_simulate_operation
functions.description: Simulate a sd wan lifecycle operation (e.g. change, deploy, terminate) without committing changes, returning predicted effects and warnings.

snapshot_id.description: Optional snapshot id to simulate against a frozen state.

functions.returns: Simulation report with predicted state diff, dependency impacts, warnings, errors, and cost estimate.

functions.name: sd_wan_lifecycle_request_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a pending sd wan lifecycle change, with reviewers, justification, and SLA.
functions.returns: Approval request record including approval_request_id, status, due_at, and current quorum.

functions.name: sd_wan_lifecycle_record_approval_decision
functions.description: Record an individual approver's decision on a pending sd wan lifecycle approval request and advance the workflow.

side_effects.description: Optional side effects of this decision.

functions.returns: Updated approval request state including remaining required approvers and whether the request is now finalized.

functions.name: sd_wan_lifecycle_add_comment
functions.description: Attach a comment, internal note, or @-mention to a sd wan lifecycle entity for collaboration.

body.description: Markdown or rich-text body of the comment.

functions.returns: Created comment record including comment_id, created_at, and notification fan-out summary.

functions.name: sd_wan_lifecycle_attach_evidence
functions.description: Attach one or more evidence files (logs, screenshots, contracts, diagnostics) to a sd wan lifecycle entity.
functions.returns: Attachment registration result with stored attachment IDs, virus-scan status, and any redactions applied.

functions.name: sd_wan_lifecycle_create_snapshot
functions.description: Create a point-in-time snapshot of a sd wan lifecycle entity (and optionally its dependencies) for restore or comparison.
functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor including snapshot_id, size, scope manifest, and retention date.

functions.name: sd_wan_lifecycle_restore_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a sd wan lifecycle entity from a previously captured snapshot, with conflict-resolution and dry-run options.
functions.returns: Restore result including restored entity id, conflicts, applied paths, and the resulting state version.

functions.name: sd_wan_lifecycle_get_kpi_metrics
functions.description: Compute aggregated KPIs and time series for sd wan lifecycle activity over a time range, grouped by chosen dimensions.
functions.returns: Aggregated KPI snapshot with per-bucket time series, totals, and optional period-over-period deltas.

functions.name: sd_wan_lifecycle_pin_to_dashboard
functions.description: Pin a sd wan lifecycle view, metric, or saved query to an operations dashboard for at-a-glance monitoring.
functions.returns: Created dashboard tile descriptor including tile_id, dashboard_id, and effective configuration.

functions.name: sd_wan_lifecycle_upsert_policy
functions.description: Create or update a governance/automation policy that applies to sd wan lifecycle entities with rule conditions and actions.
functions.returns: Policy descriptor including policy_id, current version, rule count, and validation warnings.

functions.name: sd_wan_lifecycle_evaluate_policy
functions.description: Evaluate one or more policies against a given sd wan lifecycle payload or live entity and return decisions and matched rules.

target.description: Either an entity reference or an inline payload to evaluate.

functions.returns: Policy evaluation report listing decisions (allow/deny/remediate), matched rules, and explanations per rule.

functions.name: sd_wan_lifecycle_get_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the dependency or association graph for a sd wan lifecycle entity, including inbound and outbound links.
functions.returns: Graph response containing nodes and edges up to the requested depth with edge labels and metadata.

functions.name: sd_wan_lifecycle_manage_links_and_tags
functions.description: Add, remove or replace tags and cross-entity links for a sd wan lifecycle entity in a single atomic operation.

links.description: Links to add, remove, or update.

functions.returns: Updated entity reference with applied tag and link changes plus any conflicts encountered.
